english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on rules or requirements imposed to control an activity, rather than on the body supervising it.

examples.english: The government uses new regulatory laws to control online lending and protect borrowers.
examples.traditional: 政府用新法例規管網上放貸，保障借款人。
